lead.en: Show host-provided provider health and incident history.
lead.zh: 展示宿主提供的服务状态和事件记录。

rule.en: The host owns data, polling, visibility and opening incident URLs. The example uses simulated data. Select a daily bar to focus it; arrow keys move between days, and the selected date, health, uptime and note are exposed as its accessible value.
rule.zh: 宿主负责数据、轮询、可见性以及打开事件链接。预览使用模拟数据。 点击每日状态条会聚焦该条；方向键切换日期，所选日期、健康状态、可用率和备注作为无障碍值提供。

api.en: On Refresh capture current_request and return using set_providers_for or set_error_for; these ignore older and settled checks. Legacy unscoped setters require host-side stale-response filtering. The host drives set_remaining_seconds.
api.zh: 收到 Refresh 后捕获 current_request，通过 set_providers_for 或 set_error_for 返回结果；旧请求和已结束请求会被忽略。旧的无编号方法需宿主自行过滤过期响应。倒计时由宿主调用 set_remaining_seconds 更新。

motion.en: Incident details use a 240 ms spring and measured height; reduced motion shows the final state. Visual and touch verification are pending.
motion.zh: 事件详情按实测内容高度使用 240ms 弹簧展开；减少动效时直接切换。视觉与触屏实测仍待完成。
